# Vendor brand marks

These SVGs identify the model vendor a catalog group belongs to. They are the
brand marks of their owners and appear only as provider identification.

Source: [lobehub/lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons),
`packages/static-svg/icons`, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 LobeHub. The full
license text ships with the package at `packages/client/ui-model-selection/README.md`
("Brand marks" section); upstream files are copied unmodified except for the
file names listed below.

| Local file | Upstream file | Renders as |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek.svg` | `deepseek-color.svg` | DeepSeek mark, brand blue |
| `anthropic.svg` | `claude-color.svg` | Claude mark, brand orange |
| `openai.svg` | `openai.svg` | OpenAI knot, masks to the theme's label color |
| `google.svg` | `gemini-color.svg` | Gemini mark, brand gradient |
| `xai.svg` | `xai.svg` | xAI mark, masks to the theme's label color |
| `moonshot.svg` | `moonshot.svg` | MoonshotAI mark, masks to the theme's label color |
| `qwen.svg` | `qwen-color.svg` | Qwen mark, brand blue |
| `zai.svg` | `zai.svg` | Z.ai mark, masks to the theme's label color |
| `composer.svg` | `cursor.svg` | Cursor mark, masks to the theme's label color |

The DeepSeek mark (`ui-deepseek-model-label-1017`) and other first-party assets
keep their own owners; only third-party provider marks live here.
